standouts.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: On the weekly chart: five clean waves up from Oct 23, 2023 to Aug 18, 2025 (+122%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−23% to −34%), in three waves, with the Feb 26, 2024 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−48%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+16%) says wave 3 is under way.

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range

against.head: Stretched above its 50-day

standouts.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Jun 3 to Jul 31 (+57%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−14% to −21%), on lighter volume, with the Jun 17 high in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−30%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+10%) says wave 3 is under way.
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.

standouts.head: Broke out of a 4-week base

standouts.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.

standouts.head: MACD positive

against.head: Uptrend structure broken, then reclaimed
against.text: On Sep 8 it closed under the Aug 11 higher low, ending the run of higher lows, and it has closed back over that low since; the larger swings (4 ATR) are intact.
against.learn: An uptrend steps up in higher highs and higher lows; a lower high is the first warning, and a close under the last higher low breaks it.
